title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub portfolios using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, generates embeddings from READMEs, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server to find reusable code patterns across a user's portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for REST services, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth.
how_to_apply: Install the package, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories, and serve the web UI or use the CLI/MCP server to search your codebase semantically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Client-side semantic search using TF-IDF and embeddings
Auto-clustering of repos into capability categories
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Faceted filtering by language, topics, and stars
Weekly automated reindexing via GitHub Actions
Embeddable widget and shareable search URLs
